create_SceneBatchSampler: create a SceneBatchSampler instance to sample training batches with controlled sequence composition for 3D video datasets
sample_consecutive_frames_batch: sample consecutive frame intervals from sequences using a pivot-based temporal window strategy
build_segment_index: build a segment index mapping each frame to its contiguous segment for efficient pivot-based frame selection
split_to_segments: split a sequence of frames into contiguous segments based on frame number or timestamp gap thresholds
cull_short_segments: cull segments shorter than a minimum size and return the longest segment if all are too short
